piezime: Both lists are HTML tables inline in the 2021 plan: table 36 (chapter 6.2, assembly points) and table 38 (chapter 6.5, temporary accommodation). No coordinates and no row numbers; accommodation rows are grouped under town/parish header rows (kept in piezime, addresses already contain the parish). Gultas 'Nav' recorded as 0; one row lists capacity 240 but 250 beds (Rīgas Valsts tehnikums dienesta viesnīca). The per-parish *-pagasts.md / *-pilseta.md files are maps with no extractable text.
